description: Audio-visual and Interactive Media (Telecommunication and Video Games) is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Telecommunications Regulatory Authority. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Culture & Media. Its keywords are Telecommunication, Video Games. The portal shows 35 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
